label: Intel NUC 13 Pro (NUC13ANHi7)
description: 4x4-inch mini PC, 13th-gen Core i7-1360P, one 2.5GbE RJ45 plus Wi-Fi 6E and two Thunderbolt 4 ports.
notes: 2.5GbE RJ45 (Intel i226) on a 4x4-inch chassis - a compact host that can actually use a 2.5G access port. Wi-Fi 6E AX211 onboard; common as a lab broker/VM host node.
